project_evolution.title: NSP Portfolio Builder — Project Evolution
project_evolution.note: V15.1 identifies this fresh Project Evolution operational record. It does not claim that an external PES-15.1 schema has been formally published.

source_baseline.current_source_release_note: Browser 209: full central-content scroll instead of nested tree scroll, three switchable gallery appearance themes, exact shared Once icons with inline Latin 1, and a 220ms hover dwell for auto-hide layers/history. Owner runtime review pending.

product_definition.page_templates: Shared categorized page templates; placing a template creates page-owned elements, not live Master/Section inheritance
product_definition.custom_components: Project-scoped reusable linked components placed with the shared Toolbox; instance geometry stays local
product_definition.styles: One central shared Style Library, subject to runtime verification
product_definition.media: Project-private library with explicit global image sharing; actual ownership and import/export behavior need runtime verification
product_definition.editor: Shared page designer with Dock, layers, properties, groups/blocks, history and print/export paths

verification.caveat: The source can contain defects. Project Evolution reset does not reset browser IndexedDB or prove application correctness.
